en: A black-and-white postcard photograph depicting a historic brick building with a central clock tower and pointed spire. The structure has Gothic-revival style elements, visible in the arched windows and decorative battlements. Steps lead up to an arched entryway, and there are some small bushes and public benches outside. The text 'Rathaus Drebkau/N. L.' appears in the lower right-hand corner.
